senses.gloss: प्र-डीन mfn. (√ डी) flown up or forward, taking flight, R.; Mṛcch.
प्र-डीन n. the act of flying, flying forward, MBh.
प्राडाहति m. patr. g. तौल्वल्यादि (v.l. प्राणाहति, Kāś.)
प्राड्-विवाक See under 3. प्राश्, p. 709, col. 2.
प्राड्-विवाक m. ‘one who interrogates and discriminates’, a judge (esp. the chief j˚ of a stationary court), Mn.; Gaut.; Bhar. (cf. IW. 296, 1).
